meta.title: Maison Blanche | Luxury Boutique Hotel Amalfi Coast
meta.description: A sun-drenched editorial stay on the Amalfi Coast.

hero.subtitle: Experience the timeless elegance of the Amalfi Coast in a sanctuary where every detail is a curated masterpiece.

story.lead: It all began with a fisherman's house, a family, and the quiet conviction that hospitality was their true calling.
story.quote: We never built a hotel. We opened the doors of our home, and never stopped.

milestones.title: The summer house
milestones.text: Elena and Vittorio Bianchi buy a fisherman's house in Positano for their family summers, among lemon trees and sea salt.

milestones.title: The first tables
milestones.text: Dinners for friends become legendary, and the house opens its first six sea-facing rooms.

milestones.title: The second generation
milestones.text: Their children turn the house into a boutique hotel, preserving every beam, tile and original corner.

milestones.title: The third generation
milestones.text: Elena's grandchildren keep the same ritual: welcoming every guest as if they were arriving home.

detail.reserveNote: Our concierge will reply within 24 hours.

quotes.text: There are places you visit once, and places that change how you breathe forever. Maison Blanche is the second.
quotes.author: Isabella Montgomery

quotes.text: A sanctuary of stillness where architecture, sea and service are perfectly choreographed.
quotes.author: Luca Ferri

quotes.text: Every corner feels intentionally designed. Warm, elegant, unforgettable.
quotes.author: Emma Clarke
